e.title: Global Shield（全球气候风险盾）：G7/V20 的 CDRFI 工具箱与国别进程
e.title_en: The Global Shield against Climate Risks: a G7/V20 CDRFI instrument toolbox and in-country process
e.title_hk: Global Shield（全球氣候風險盾）：G7/V20 的 CDRFI 工具箱與國別進程
e.summary: G7 与 V20 联合发起的气候与灾害风险融资与保险（CDRFI）倡议：以「风险管理→风险分层→CDRFI 工具→效益」为框架提供工具箱，通过「国别进程」在脆弱国家建设能力，设协调中心与技术顾问组
e.summary_en: A joint G7 and V20 initiative on Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI): it offers an instrument toolbox framed as risk management → risk layering → CDRFI instruments → benefits, builds capacity in vulnerable countries through an in-country process, and runs a coordination hub and technical advisory group
e.summary_hk: G7 與 V20 聯合發起的氣候與災害風險融資與保險（CDRFI）倡議：以「風險管理→風險分層→CDRFI 工具→效益」為框架提供工具箱，通過「國別進程」在脆弱國家建設能力，設協調中心與技術顧問組
e.body:
**Global Shield against Climate Risks（全球气候风险盾）** 是**G7 与 V20（易受气候影响国家集团）联合发起的主权气候风险融资倡议**。站点首页正文实测写明它是 **「A joint G7/V20 initiative to strengthen the financial protection and resilience of [脆弱国家]」**。本条目补的是**「把风险分层做成国家级工具箱」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**（池内已有主权风险池 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]，**但那是「已建成的池」；本条是「面向多国的工具箱与建设进程」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **「Instruments（工具）」页 `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` 实测 127.2KB，标题「Instruments | The Global Shield against Climate Risks」**，正文实测写明 **「A toolbox of tailored CDRFI instruments for the Global Shield」**，⭐ **并写明它「facilitates Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI) instruments to help vulnerable countries close protection gaps」**，以及 **「This is enabled through an In-Country Process, which fosters sustainable and inclusive CDRFI capacities within the country」**；⭐ **该页实测的层级结构为：Risk Management → Risk Layering → CDRFI Instruments → Key benefits of CDRFI**（**即把「风险管理 → 风险分层 → 工具 → 效益」作为叙述框架**）；⭐ **「Financing Structure（融资结构）」页 `/about/financing-structure-global-shield/` 实测 157.5KB**；⭐ **「Where we work（我们在哪些国家工作）」页 `/where-we-work/` 实测 2097.2KB**（**本站最大页面，提示为较完整的国别清单或地图应用**）；站点首页实测 133.6KB。**导航逐字实测揭示的结构**：**What we offer** 下含 **Value proposition**、**Instruments**、**Process**、**Capacity Support**；**Where we work**；**Get Involved** 下含 **Access Support**、**Join a Country Community**、**Events**；**About** 下含 **Vision & Mission**、**Global Shield Setup**、**Board**、**Financing Structure**、**Coordination Hub**、**Technical Advisory Group**、**Secretariat**；另有 **Resources** 与 **FAQ**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「风险分层（risk layering）在主权层的操作化」这一层**——**风险分层是保险与风险管理的基础概念（自留/保险/再保/资本市场逐层转移）**，**而 Global Shield 把它直接做成一国可用的工具箱**：**以「风险管理 → 风险分层 → CDRFI 工具 → 效益」组织页面**；**对想做主权风险融资或公共部门风险管理的学生，这是一个把教科书概念落到国家级操作的样本**（可与 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 并读——**「已建成的池 vs 建设池的进程 vs 监管能力建设 vs 微型保险」四种路径**）。**② ⭐ 「国别进程（In-Country Process）」与「加入国家共同体（Join a Country Community）」是两个值得注意的机制设计**——**不是外部机构直接给钱给保险，而是在国内培育可持续能力**；**这与池内 [[a2ii]] 的监管者能力建设思路同源**（**都强调「本地能力」而非「一次性方案」**）。**③ 治理结构实测含有「协调中心（Coordination Hub）」「技术顾问组（Technical Advisory Group）」与「秘书处」**——**对研究国际倡议如何组织（G7 出资源、V20 出需求、秘书处与顾问组出执行）的学生，这是一个具体样本**（可与 [[bis-fsi]] 的监管者能力建设、[[iais-icp]] 的国际原则层并读）。**④ 与 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 的关系值得留意**——**Global Shield 是「倡议与进程」，CCRIF/SEADRIF 是「已运行的风险池」**；**两者在现实中可能存在项目层面的衔接，但本次未核实，故本词条不作关联陈述**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与三个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、三处关键正文表述、页面层级结构、以及导航逐字实测的治理与流程结构**，**但未打开任何工具详情、未打开融资结构的具体数字、未打开「我们在哪些国家工作」的国别清单内容、未打开任何 Resources 文件**，因此**不能转述任何资助金额、参与国家名单、工具的具体设计或项目进展**；**② ⭐ 「Where we work」页体量 2097.2KB 为实测值**，**该页是否为一个国别地图/数据库应用、其可检索性如何，本次未核实**（**故本词条不主张可通过该页查询具体国家**）；**③ 「CDRFI」为站点自身使用的缩写（Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance），已在词条内写明其展开**；**④ Global Shield 与 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 是否有项目层面衔接本次未核实——词条内已明确不作关联陈述**；**⑤ 该倡议的存续状态、资金来源与已承诺规模本次未核实**（**站点存在不等于现已全面运作**）；**⑥ 站点为 WordPress 建站**（实测可见 `/wp-content/uploads/` 资源路径），**部分导航项指向 `?page_id=` 形式**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Global Shield 提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：首页（133.6KB）、`/instruments-offer-financial-tools/`（127.2KB）、`/about/financing-structure-global-shield/`（157.5KB）、`/where-we-work/`（2097.2KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取正文与导航；**未打开工具详情、融资数字、国别清单内容或 Resources 文件**。

e.body_en:
**The Global Shield against Climate Risks** is **a sovereign climate risk financing initiative jointly launched by the G7 and the V20** (the group of climate-vulnerable countries). Its homepage states verbatim that it is **"A joint G7/V20 initiative to strengthen the financial protection and resilience of [vulnerable countries]"**. This entry adds the **"risk layering turned into a country-level instrument toolbox"** form — **that form measured zero** (the corpus has sovereign risk pools in [[seadrif]] and [[ccrif]], **but those are pools already built; this is a toolbox and a process aimed at many countries**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **"Instruments" page `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` measures 127.2KB with the title "Instruments | The Global Shield against Climate Risks"**, stating verbatim **"A toolbox of tailored CDRFI instruments for the Global Shield"**, ⭐ stating that it **"facilitates Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI) instruments to help vulnerable countries close protection gaps"**, and adding **"This is enabled through an In-Country Process, which fosters sustainable and inclusive CDRFI capacities within the country"**; ⭐ **the page’s measured hierarchy is: Risk Management → Risk Layering → CDRFI Instruments → Key benefits of CDRFI** (**i.e. it frames the narrative as risk management → risk layering → instruments → benefits**); ⭐ the **"Financing Structure" page measures 157.5KB**; ⭐ the **"Where we work" page measures 2097.2KB** (**the site’s largest page, suggesting a fairly complete country list or map application**); the homepage measures 133.6KB. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the structure**: under **What we offer** — **Value proposition**, **Instruments**, **Process**, **Capacity Support**; **Where we work**; under **Get Involved** — **Access Support**, **Join a Country Community**, **Events**; under **About** — **Vision & Mission**, **Global Shield Setup**, **Board**, **Financing Structure**, **Coordination Hub**, **Technical Advisory Group** and **Secretariat**; plus **Resources** and **FAQ**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the operationalisation of risk layering at sovereign level** — **risk layering is a foundational insurance and risk-management concept (retention, insurance, reinsurance, capital markets, each layer transferring risk)**, **and the Global Shield turns it into a toolbox a country can use**, organising its pages as **risk management → risk layering → CDRFI instruments → benefits**; **for students working on sovereign risk financing or public-sector risk management this is a sample of a textbook concept implemented at national level** (readable with [[seadrif]], [[ccrif]], [[a2ii]] and [[microinsurance-network]] — **four paths: a pool already built, a process for building pools, supervisory capacity building, and microinsurance**). **② ⭐ The "In-Country Process" and "Join a Country Community" are notable mechanism designs** — **not an external body simply handing over money and insurance, but cultivating sustainable capacity domestically**; **this shares its logic with [[a2ii]]’s supervisory capacity building** (**both emphasise local capability over one-off solutions**). **③ The measured governance includes a "Coordination Hub", a "Technical Advisory Group" and a "Secretariat"** — **a concrete sample for studying how international initiatives organise (G7 providing resources, V20 demand, secretariat and advisory group delivery)** (readable with [[bis-fsi]] and the international-principles layer of [[iais-icp]]). **④ Its relationship with [[ccrif]] and [[seadrif]] deserves attention** — **the Global Shield is an initiative and process; CCRIF and SEADRIF are pools already running**; **there may be project-level links in practice, but these were not verified, so this entry makes no claim about them**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and sizes of the homepage and three functional pages, three key verbatim body statements, the page hierarchy, and the governance and process structure read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no instrument detail, no financing figures, no country-list content on "Where we work", and no Resources file**, so **no funding amount, participating country list, instrument design or project progress can be restated**; **② ⭐ the 2097.2KB size of the "Where we work" page is a measured value**, **but whether it is a country map or database application, and how searchable it is, were not verified** (**so this entry does not claim the page can be used to look up specific countries**); **③ "CDRFI" is the site’s own abbreviation (Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance), expanded in the entry**; **④ whether the Global Shield links at project level to [[ccrif]] or [[seadrif]] was not verified — the entry explicitly makes no such claim**; **⑤ the initiative’s current status, funding sources and committed amounts were not verified** (**a site existing does not mean it is fully operating**); **⑥ the site runs on WordPress** (measurably serving `/wp-content/uploads/` assets), **with some navigation items pointing to `?page_id=` URLs**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the Global Shield provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (133.6KB), `/instruments-offer-financial-tools/` (127.2KB), `/about/financing-structure-global-shield/` (157.5KB) and `/where-we-work/` (2097.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with body text and navigation read verbatim; **no instrument detail, financing figure, country-list content or Resources file was opened**.

e.body_hk:
**Global Shield against Climate Risks（全球氣候風險盾）** 是**G7 與 V20（易受氣候影響國家集團）聯合發起的主權氣候風險融資倡議**。首頁正文實測寫明它是 **「A joint G7/V20 initiative to strengthen the financial protection and resilience of…」**。本條目補的是**「把風險分層做成國家級工具箱」這一形態**——**實測該形態為 0**（池內已有主權風險池 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]，**但那是「已建成的池」；本條是「面向多國的工具箱與建設進程」**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **「Instruments」頁 127.2KB**，正文寫明 **「A toolbox of tailored CDRFI instruments for the Global Shield」**，⭐ 並寫明它 **「facilitates Climate and Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance (CDRFI) instruments to help vulnerable countries close protection gaps」**，以及 **「This is enabled through an In-Country Process, which fosters sustainable and inclusive CDRFI capacities within the country」**；⭐ **該頁實測層級為：Risk Management → Risk Layering → CDRFI Instruments → Key benefits of CDRFI**；⭐ **「Financing Structure」頁 157.5KB**；⭐ **「Where we work」頁 2097.2KB**（**本站最大頁面**）；首頁 133.6KB。**導航逐字實測**：**What we offer** 含 **Value proposition／Instruments／Process／Capacity Support**；**Get Involved** 含 **Access Support／Join a Country Community／Events**；**About** 含 **Vision & Mission／Global Shield Setup／Board／Financing Structure／Coordination Hub／Technical Advisory Group／Secretariat**；另有 **Resources／FAQ**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「風險分層（risk layering）在主權層的操作化」**——**以「風險管理 → 風險分層 → 工具 → 效益」組織頁面**，**是教科書概念落到國家級操作的樣本**（可與 [[seadrif]]、[[ccrif]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 並讀——**四種路徑**）。**② ⭐ 「國別進程」與「加入國家共同體」是值得注意的機制設計**——**不是外部機構直接給錢給保險，而是在國內培育可持續能力**，與 [[a2ii]] 同源。**③ 治理結構實測含「協調中心」「技術顧問組」與「秘書處」**——**對研究國際倡議如何組織的學生是具體樣本**。**④ 與 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 的關係值得留意**——**一個是倡議與進程，另兩個是已運行的池**；**本次未核實項目層面銜接，故不作關聯陳述**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與三個功能頁的存在、標題、體量、三處關鍵正文、頁面層級、導航逐字實測的治理與流程結構**，**但未打開任何工具詳情、未打開融資結構具體數字、未打開國別清單內容、未打開任何 Resources 文件**，故**不能轉述任何資助金額、參與國家名單、工具設計或項目進展**；**② ⭐ 2097.2KB 為「Where we work」實測體量**，**該頁是否為國別地圖／數據庫應用、可檢索性如何未核實**（**故不主張可查詢具體國家**）；**③ 「CDRFI」為站點自身縮寫，已在詞條內展開**；**④ 與 [[ccrif]]、[[seadrif]] 的項目層面銜接未核實，詞條內已明確不作關聯陳述**；**⑤ 倡議存續狀態、資金來源與已承諾規模未核實**；**⑥ 站點為 WordPress 建站**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Global Shield 提供精算工具、模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取正文與導航；**未打開工具詳情、融資數字、國別清單內容或 Resources 文件**。
